findings.evidence: Opaque refs allowed non-zero unused pad-bit aliases with the same decoded value.
findings.required_change: Require canonical base64url decode/re-encode equality and freeze decoded constraints.
findings.verification: Canonical and alias/invalid vectors agree across implementations.

findings.evidence: Self-digest-bearing contracts had no exact digest-input projection, producing circular or implementation-defined hashing.
findings.required_change: Freeze and bind an exact projection schema and validation order for every such contract.
findings.verification: Source, projection, preimage and digest vectors agree across implementations.

findings.evidence: Empty all/any and operand/error order were not normative.
findings.required_change: Define emptiness, per-operator evaluation sequence and total error precedence.
findings.verification: Permuted serialization and simultaneous-failure vectors yield identical results.

findings.evidence: The cost schedule omitted result-affecting recursive and temporary-work accounting.
findings.required_change: Freeze the complete abstract resource-accounting schedule and E_LIMIT/E_BUDGET precedence.
findings.verification: Cross-implementation boundary vectors cover every primitive and compound cost.
